'''Withering Refugees''' can be found in [[Brinthilien]] in the [[Thalassian Highlands]] and in the [[Wretched Ghetto]] in the high elven capital of [[Alah'Thalas]]. They are high elves who are in the process of succumbing to their arcane addiction and becoming [[Withered Refugee|withered]].
